what_this_data_cannot_tell_us: No marketing spend per channel (ad budgets, referral rewards, time on Instagram), so channel profit cannot be calculated.
Delivery cost is an estimate: studio hours per service from costs.csv and editor hours x hourly rate; owner time, equipment and overheads are not in the data.
Whether anyone replied to client messages: messages.txt holds only 3 outbound message(s) out of 193, so response times to clients cannot be measured.
What Axeom owes its team or suppliers: there are no payroll, bill or bank-out records, only pay rates and hours (an incurred-cost estimate is given, not a debt).
